Note on Claim Listings

When a member signs up by claiming an existing listing, this same signup webhook fires — a claim is a first-time signup, so the Member Plan Changed webhook does not fire. Claim signups include two additional variables, Claim and Claim Listing , each containing the claimed listing’s unique token. These variables are not present on ordinary signups, so an external automation can detect a claim by checking that claim_listing exists and is not empty. A claim that lands on a free plan fires the free member signup webhook instead, with the same two variables.
